author: EOS Systems Architect & Product Owner
description: Approved implementation DAG for Level 2 Controlled First Write. Includes PO-approved Decision Gates (GAP-005 LOCAL_GIT_ONLY, GAP-003 OPTION_A), metadata dir exception for .git, and strict Target Mutation Audit.

tasks.name: Initialize Target Repository Hygiene
tasks.governance_check: DECISION-GATE-005 APPROVED (LOCAL_GIT_ONLY). Remote repos, tokens, and push FORBIDDEN.

tasks.name: Scaffold Package Configuration & Verifier
tasks.action: create package.json with Vite dev server & test scripts
tasks.governance_check: Zero external dependencies beyond Vite and standard linters

tasks.name: Implement Semantic HTML5 Core Layout
tasks.action: create index.html with WCAG AA accessibility & SVG placeholders (GAP-001)
tasks.governance_check: 100% semantic HTML5 tags, ARIA labels, and WCAG AA contrast ratio >= 4.5:1

tasks.name: Implement CSS Design System & Responsive Layout
tasks.action: create src/styles/main.css with CSS custom properties & fluid layout
tasks.governance_check: Pure vanilla CSS; responsive breakpoints for mobile/tablet/desktop

tasks.name: Implement Legal Config Schema (GAP-002)
tasks.action: create src/config/legal.json with UNKNOWN tokens pending PO input
tasks.governance_check: Strict prohibition of invented legal data (UNKNOWN tokens stay UNKNOWN)

tasks.name: Implement Informational Donation Section (GAP-003 Option A)
tasks.action: implement static bank transfer & contact info section in index.html and src/js/main.js
tasks.governance_check: DECISION-GATE-003 APPROVED (OPTION_A_STATIC_BANK_INFO). Payment SDKs & credentials FORBIDDEN.

tasks.name: Prepare Build & Deployment Manifest (GAP-004 IaC Prep)
tasks.action: create build & IaC deployment configuration manifest (deployment.manifest.json) in target project
tasks.governance_check: Decoupled from content tasks; IaC prep only, cloud deployment & DNS strictly DENIED

tasks.name: Execute Verification & Target Mutation Audit
tasks.action: run npm run verify:strict, execute Target Mutation Audit, & generate EVD-FUNDACION-LEVEL2-001
mutation_audit_rules: every created/modified file ∈ approved DAG target_files OR authorized_metadata_dirs (.git)
every modification attributable to an authorized task
no unexpected file creation outside target_files
no secret or private key introduced
no file outside declared write scope modified
tasks.governance_check: Verification of verification & 100% strict target mutation audit
